direction: observed structure score greater than matched-null structure score
primary_inference: exact station-level sign test combined with UI and NSS gates
null_monte_carlo: 127 deterministic parent-local children plus observed correction
missing_cells: never imputed; excluded only under the frozen eligibility rule and retained in denominators where failure fraction is defined
primary_conditions: baseline linear adjacency determines T_e; six frozen survival conditions determine S_e
leave_one_parent_out: recompute primary baseline endpoints after omitting each eligible parent when at least 10 remain; descriptive robustness only
cyclic_adjacency: secondary diagnostic with independently Holm-adjusted primary-grid sign p values
structured_fragility: report deltas in UI, NSS, SEP, and T_e for each frozen perturbation without selecting a preferred condition

fourteen_specificity.paired_test: exact one-sided sign test across eligible parents for closure_error(14) < closure_error(comparator)
fourteen_specificity.gate: 14 is the unique study-level minimum, every paired comparison is Holm-adjusted p<=0.05, and baseline SEP(14) is true so the effect also survives parent-matched nulls

domain_baseline: report frozen train/test prediction errors and recompute SEP on climatology-plus-AR(1) residuals
numeric_policy: float64 without outcome-driven rounding; publication tables may display rounded copies while machine JSON retains full precision
